The object of the verbs जासि 'to strike', 'to hurt', हन् 'to strike' preceded by नि and ग्र , नाट् 'to injure', क्राथ and पिष when they mean 'to injure', takes the 6th-Case-affix.

Terms: विभक्ति-6

After a Pronominal अङ्ग (stem) ending in अ , ई is substituted for the Nominative 1st-Case plural अस्।

Terms: Some substitution

After a neutral अङ्ग (stem), इ is substituted for the endings (जस् and शस्) of Nominative 1st-Case and Accusative -2nd case.

Terms: Some substitution

Before the affix अस्of the Nominative 1st-Case plural गुण is substituted for the final short vowel of a Nominal-stem.

Terms: गुण in Feminine
